component.name: VCV Rack Plugin Installer
component.summary: Install and upgrade VCV Rack 2 plugin packages

description.p: VCV Rack 2 unpacks .vcvplugin packages from its plugins folder the next time it starts, without saying what changed. This installer checks each package first, shows what installing it will do, and unpacks it right away.

ul.li: Rejects packages built for another operating system or CPU, or without a valid plugin.json
Shows whether each package is a new install, an upgrade or a downgrade
Warns when the same version is already installed with different files
Replaces older packages that are still waiting for Rack to unpack them

description.p: Plugins are unpacked into a staging folder and then swapped into place, so an interrupted install does not leave a half-written plugin behind. The vcvplugin-install command does the same from a terminal.

A new icon following the GNOME guidelines, with a symbolic variant

The desktop entry lists only the Audio category, so the app appears once in application menus
Code style checked with ruff in CI
